notes.title: 100 Cats Lost in Japan: Find & Color — Patch Notes v1.00
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635476/10a1cc47af9eb1fa1c5f5623168a340e89529a92.png"]Updates / Improvements 


🏠 Homepage revamped  now cuter and more inviting. 


🏆 Leaderboard system added; rankings make competition visible.



🎥 Fixed a minor bug in the replay viewer. 



Special Offer



🎉 Launch special: Get 30% off the “100 Cats Lost Bundle” when purchased together with 100 Cats Lost in World: Find & Color and 100 Cats Lost in Poland.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Achievements can now be displayed in-game 

Mouse and gamepad can now be used simultaneously for cursor movement only

Gamepad sensitivity increased by 4x (Now matches the movement speed of WASD controls)
